## Organization and your role

## Which assessments or rows you are responding to
Dimension and current value, or row ids.

## Your response
Facts, documents, or terms you are publishing. Each statement is filed as a signal with `source_type: self` and the date received; a linked public document raises the tier.

## Publication
May we quote this issue as the source? (yes / no; if no, send documents by email and we file a summary)
